title: Exact derivation preserves pasting of comparison squares
statement: Let F:C0→C1, G:C1→C2, P:D0→D1, Q:D1→D2 and Ei:Ci→Di be exact additive functors between abelian categories with derived categories. For α:F⋙E1≅E0⋙P and β:G⋙E2≅E1⋙Q, the derived square comparison of their paste equals the composition of the derived comparisons for β and α, with the derived composition comparisons at the endpoints.

proof.text: Expand mapDerivedCategorySquareIso. Apply preservation of composition of natural isomorphisms and the two whiskering laws. Apply associativity of the derived composition comparison at F,G,E2; F,E1,Q; and E0,P,Q. Cancel intermediate inverses. The four surviving factors give the required equality.

lean.statement:
theorem mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_paste (α : F ⋙ E₁ ≅ E₀ ⋙ P) (β : G ⋙ E₂ ≅ E₁ ⋙ Q) :
    (mapDerivedCategorySquareIso (F₁ := F ⋙ G) (F₂ := E₂)
      (G₁ := E₀) (G₂ := P ⋙ Q) (isoWhiskerLeft F β ≪≫ isoWhiskerRight α Q)).hom =
      (isoWhiskerRight (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F G) D(E₂)).hom ≫
        (isoWhiskerLeft D(F) (mapDerivedCategorySquareIso β)).hom ≫
        (isoWhiskerRight (mapDerivedCategorySquareIso α) D(Q)).hom ≫
        (isoWhiskerLeft D(E₀) (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso P Q)).inv
